description: This file defines the Warn class in the ScssPhp namespace, responsible for handling warning and deprecation messages, particularly for SCSS PHP compilation. It includes methods to set warning callbacks and to report warnings, with restrictions on invocation context.

classes.name: Warn
classes.description: Final class responsible for handling warning messages and deprecation notices within the SCSS PHP compiler.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Prints a warning message associated with the current import or function call, only callable within a custom function or importer callback.

methods.name: deprecation
methods.description: Prints a deprecation warning message associated with the current import or function call, only callable within a custom function or importer callback.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function for handling warnings, returning the previous callback.

methods.name: reportWarning
methods.description: Internal method to invoke the warning callback, passing message and deprecation status; throws exception if callback not set.
